name: CommandOpts
lead: The options of `commands.add`: a permission node, aliases, the /help line and suggestions per argument.

fields.name: permission
fields.description: A permission node; without it the command is not shown and not run.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: More names for the same command: { "hub", "lobby" }.

fields.name: help
fields.description: The line /help shows after the usage.

fields.name: suggest
fields.description: Per argument name: the words to offer, or a function that returns them.
